surface: Echo-compatible explicit-node SmartEdge plus the framework-neutral routing core: A*/jump-point search, obstacle grids and bounds, endpoint alignment, SVG draw functions, subflow preparation, waypoint routing, floating geometry, and a bounded shared-grid cache.
divergences: SmartEdge receives nodes explicitly and has no @xyflow/react runtime or peer; it can be embedded by any Octane flow renderer with XYFlow-shaped nodes and edge props.
Obstacle bounds follow @xyflow/system dimension precedence and per-node origin semantics, correcting upstream 4.13.0's measured-only, top-left-origin assumption.

Editable control points, circuit hops, SmartEdgeBatchRoutingProvider/useSmartEdgeRoute, React Flow store hooks, connection-line components, and preset edge components are not exposed until a real Octane XYFlow binding owns those integration contracts.
Fallback components must be Octane components; the built-in fallback is the framework-neutral @xyflow/system Bezier path.
ssr: Supported and tested: routed SVG paths and labels render on the server, and hydration adopts the existing SVG hosts while retaining live prop updates.
notes: The shared cache stores only endpoint-independent obstacle matrices, uses an unambiguous structured geometry key, is capped at eight signatures, and creates a fresh mutable search grid for every route.
Pure routing differential tests use the pinned upstream package as the oracle.
